exposure: Internal iliac artery intraoperative vascular clamp temporary occlusion
outcome: Postoperative intensive care unit transfer rate
cohort: 153 patients diagnosed with abnormally invasive placenta between January 2018 and December 2021
finding: Vascular clamp temporary occlusion of the internal iliac artery is an effective method for controlling hemorrhage and decreasing the incidence of hysterectomy in patients with placenta increta.
